definitions.explanation: A very young child, typically under one year old.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}が{泣|な}いている。
{赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}を{抱|だ}いている。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}を{産|う}んだ。
examples.english: She gave birth to a baby.

notes:
{赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう} refers specifically to very young infants.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}: baby, infant (very young)
- {赤|あか}ちゃん: baby (slightly more casual/affectionate)
- {乳児|にゅうじ}: infant (formal/medical term)
- {幼児|ようじ}: toddler, young child
